# Event Pipeline Knowledge Base

A tiny event-processing library. This is the Karpathy-style wiki index — start
here and follow the links.

## Map

- [[overview]] — what the pipeline does and why
- [[ingestion]] — how events enter the system
- [[validation]] — the rules an event must satisfy
- [[storage]] — how validated events are persisted
- [[concepts]] — the shared vocabulary

## Flow

Events move through three stages in order: ingest, validate, store. The
ingestion guide carries the architecture diagram.
